trigger: A frame cannot be completed without inventing a gated fact such as legal entity privacy copy a claim a person an office a credential a client outcome provider behaviour or exact public copy
action_on_trigger: Halt the batch and record the exact missing fact

trigger: The batch own stop condition in design-batch-plan.csv fires
action_on_trigger: Halt the batch and quote the row verbatim

trigger: A material change to the D-035 identity the 62 PRIM-* primitives the route set or the accepted UX architecture would be needed
action_on_trigger: Halt all production and raise a change request without amending an accepted package in place

trigger: A batch reaches three of three producer revisions with an unresolved critical high or medium finding
action_on_trigger: Halt the batch and escalate rather than starting a fourth revision

trigger: A verified free-tier limit blocks contracted evidence
action_on_trigger: Halt and report the limit and the exact shortfall and do not purchase

trigger: Any operation would require a prohibited write from WS-X-01 through WS-X-11
action_on_trigger: Refuse the operation and halt and report

trigger: Capability enablement under section 3.5 fails or a capability test would require an unofficial credential path
action_on_trigger: Halt before any external write and report the gap

trigger: The evidence would need to assert or imply WCAG conformance a test result or a live rendered page
action_on_trigger: Halt and void the artifact and re-scope the annotation

trigger: An accepted upstream package would have to be edited to make production work
action_on_trigger: Halt because accepted packages are immutable outside a change request

trigger: B07 or B09 work is requested or begun under MA-025
action_on_trigger: Refuse because both are outside scope per section 2.1

trigger: A paid licensed or non-D-035 asset would be needed
action_on_trigger: Halt and route to the paid envelope and asset-rights gate

trigger: Any external write would touch a file project or team other than the single approved one
